stemMarkdown: A bag contains 9 red balls and 4 blue balls. Two balls are drawn at random without replacement. What is the probability that both are red? (Round to 6 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Choose 2 from the 9 red balls out of 2 from all 13: $\dfrac{\binom{9}{2}}{\binom{13}{2}} = \dfrac{36}{78} = 0.461538$.
